# 同义句状态连接验收

以下为本地验收用的两只虚构怪物。Deep Wound / 深创引用当前世界已配置的同一状态，具体流血机制来自世界定义。正常攻击和伤害保留原生处理；含额外限制的能力由GM按原文裁定。

## 生物一：Language Stalker

Medium Fey, Neutral

Armor Class 15
Hit Points 90 (12d8 + 36)
Speed 30 ft.

STR 18 (+4) DEX 14 (+2) CON 16 (+3) INT 10 (+0) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 10 (+0)

Senses passive Perception 11
Languages Common
Challenge 5 (1,800 XP)
Proficiency Bonus +3

Actions

Echo Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. A creature struck by this claw suffers Deep Wound. This condition lasts one minute. After finishing each of its own turns, the victim may attempt a Constitution save with a difficulty of ten. Passing that save ends Deep Wound.

Refrain Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. For one minute after this claw hits it, the victim bears Deep Wound. The affected creature has the option to make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw whenever its own turn comes to a close; on a success, the condition is removed.

Paraphrase Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. 被这一爪击中的生物会受到深创，效果维持一分钟。每逢该生物自己的回合收尾，它可选择进行体质豁免，难度为十；通过后便摆脱这次深创。

Echoing Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. 此爪若打中目标，目标便陷入深创，为期1分钟。在每次结束自己的回合时，受影响的目标可以尝试DC10的体质豁免；豁免成功就消除该次深创。

Twilight Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. 被这一爪命中的目标受到深创，持续一分钟。只有目标处于昏暗光照中时，它才能在自己的回合结束时进行DC10体质豁免，成功则结束深创；如果目标受到任何伤害，深创也立即结束。光照限制及受伤结束均由GM裁定。

## 生物二：Training Sentinel

Medium Fey, Neutral

Armor Class 15
Hit Points 90 (12d8 + 36)
Speed 30 ft.

STR 18 (+4) DEX 14 (+2) CON 16 (+3) INT 10 (+0) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 10 (+0)

Senses passive Perception 11
Languages Common
Challenge 5 (1,800 XP)
Proficiency Bonus +3

Actions

Training Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
